soundness_flags.label: thm:atom-safe-envelope / symbol that
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed post-selection consumer is not operationally defined: T_n depends on the unknown Delta_n and E_n, while “reported regret path” and the sigma-field governing that are undefined; define an observed plug-in path and require t-hat to be measurable with respect to its observed-data sigma-field.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:uniform-path-law and thm:atom-safe-envelope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The results are conditional on fixed finite J and K, positive cell and benchmark masses, bounded outcomes, compact local contrasts, and uniformly nonsingular covariance.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform path approximation and selection-valid upper-regret coverage hold only over M(J,K,H,K_V) under these fixed finite-cell conditions.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:certified-calibration
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The certificate is intentionally one-sided and may use the conservative analytic fallback; sharp two-sided quantile accuracy is not claimed.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The algorithm guarantees conservative Gaussian CDF coverage and termination under valid effective inputs, not a prescribed numerical distance to Q_{1-alpha}^{LF}.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For fixed positive lambda, n R_lambda converges to one-half of a Gaussian quadratic form; the conclusion names data-driven benchmark-proximity-weight selection as an open direction.

The paper has the cited four authors and proves asymptotic linearity/root-n inference for an unsmoothed optimal-policy value using a growing smoothing parameter under stated gap and nuisance conditions.
A converging treatment-rule sequence is matched by a rule in a shifted-normal limit experiment.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pages 1564-1565, abstract and introduction; Theorems 2.1 and 4.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article supplies Gaussian approximation for suprema of empirical processes through finite discretization and a coupling inequality for maxima of sums of random vectors.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv primary preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 42(5), 2014
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives anti-concentration for suprema of separable Gaussian processes and applies it to honest adaptive confidence-band construction.
With a Gaussian limiting distribution, full differentiability is necessary and sufficient for ordinary-bootstrap consistency, and an alternative resampling scheme is developed.

source_verification_receipts.version: preprint corresponding to Probability Theory and Related Fields 162, 2015
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work compares smooth functions and distribution functions of maxima of Gaussian vectors under arbitrary covariance matrices and gives Gaussian-max anti-concentration.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics 1(2), 1992
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: A transformation places multivariate Gaussian probability computation into a form suitable for standard numerical multiple integration.
Taylor expansion of a multivariate-normal integral together with interval analysis and automatic differentiation self-validates calculated rectangular probabilities.

source_verification_receipts.version: authors' accessible derivation of the method later published in JRSSB 65(1), 2003
source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 1-2, non-centred orthant setup and recursive integration formulae
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The method evaluates non-centred Gaussian orthant probabilities through recursive integration after a positive-definite correlation decomposition.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define an observed, computable plug-in frontier for temperature selection, state its relation to the oracle regret path, and make the selector explicitly measurable with respect to that frontier and the sample.
Add a worked three-action numerical certificate from primitive inputs, including a non-fallback refined branch and a quantitative comparison with the fallback critical value.
Resolve the anti-concentration OEQ sufficiently to give a two-sided value-width certificate, or prove a nontrivial excess-conservativeness rate for the one-sided certificate.

recommended_next_step: Revise the post-selection object and measurability definition, then advance this field-tier novelty kernel to Stage 0.
